gold.user: User wants to create a payment for a specific call using their Twilio account. They provide the AccountSid and CallSid to identify the call and include payment details such as amount and payment method in the request body.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully create a payment and return a response with the payment details including the Sid of the newly created payment.

gold.user: User needs to update an existing payment for a call. They specify the AccountSid, CallSid, and the Sid of the payment they wish to update, along with the new payment details in the request body.
gold.ideal: The API should successfully update the payment and return a response with the updated payment details.
